title: Separate identity levels
source_issue: Agent, chemical substance, product, package and external code were mixed.
proposed_revision: Use radiopharmaceutical, molecular_entity, medicinal_product, product_package and external_identifier records.
rationale: A package code cannot identify a chemical structure; RxNorm IN/PIN/SCD/SBD and NDC product/package levels must be explicit.

title: Represent identifiers as strings
source_issue: Several blueprint identifiers use float types.
proposed_revision: Store codes as strings with scheme, version, semantic level and review state.
rationale: Preserves leading zeros and long identifiers, and avoids spreadsheet numerical rounding.

title: Separate regulation from identification
source_issue: NDC is listed among regulatory identifiers and approval is a single status.
proposed_revision: Use dated, jurisdiction-specific regulatory_authorization records and separate identifier assignments.
rationale: NDC listing does not establish FDA approval; applications, authorization holders and reference products have distinct roles.

title: Normalize ingredients and molecular roles
source_issue: Active ingredient, precise ingredient, excipient and moiety recur in multiple sections.
proposed_revision: Use product_ingredient roles and typed molecular component links.
rationale: One ingredient identity can be reused across products without duplicating its chemical definition.

title: Separate specification from physical unit
source_issue: Packaging attributes, calibration activity and fill volume share one block.
proposed_revision: Keep nominal package specifications apart from batch and radiopharmaceutical_unit measurements.
rationale: The same package presentation can contain many units with different activities, timestamps and expiries.

title: Add manufacturing and QC provenance
source_issue: The initial model lacks executable batch-level assay structure.
proposed_revision: Add material_lot, preparation_event and radiopharmaceutical_test; retain batch disposition separately.
rationale: A test needs subject, method, result status, unit, reference time and specification; pending sterility is not a failed test or an automatic release decision.

title: Distinguish specific and molar activity
source_issue: The blueprint places both in radionuclide properties; the legacy batch field combines them.
proposed_revision: Use separate timed test records for specific activity and molar activity with chemical denominator.
rationale: Bq/g and Bq/mol are different quantities, depend on chemical species and reference time, and are not nuclide constants.

title: Normalize nuclear decay data
source_issue: Branch probabilities, emission intensities and daughter chains are not clearly separated.
proposed_revision: Use radionuclide and decay_emission with branch fraction, yield per decay, energy kind and daughter links.
rationale: A photon yield is not a decay-branch probability; physical decay is not biological metabolism.

title: Give PK and binding measurements context
source_issue: Absorption, distribution, metabolism and binding entries combine multiple quantities.
proposed_revision: Use one contextual reference test per quantity, linked to evidence; use existing patient measurements and TACs for individuals.
rationale: Species, matrix, organ, time, method, statistic and analyte basis determine meaning; cohort summaries are not patient observations.

title: Keep clinical events in existing nodes
source_issue: Blueprint safety, response and dose fields overlap the Lu177-PSMA model.
proposed_revision: Reuse measurement, anatomic_target, time_activity_curve, absorbed_dose, toxicity_event, response_assessment and survival_outcome.
rationale: Avoids a parallel patient model and preserves the revised multidimensional outcome framework.

title: Add the operational medication chain
source_issue: IDRP describes procurement, prescription, dispensing and MAR separately.
proposed_revision: Add supply_offer, radiopharmaceutical_order, dispense_event and traceable unit links to administration.
rationale: Records what was requested, prepared, dispensed and actually administered without assuming these quantities are equal.

title: Separate human clinical and research scopes
source_issue: IDRP excludes preclinical work; the blueprint includes preclinical and digital-twin research.
proposed_revision: Declare human clinical, reference/preclinical and computational research profiles.
rationale: No animal or in-vitro result is silently treated as an individual human measurement.

title: Represent computation independently
source_issue: AI readiness, PBPK and prediction fields are mixed with reference agent attributes.
proposed_revision: Add computational_model, model_run, model_parameter and model_prediction with information cutoff and input provenance.
rationale: Predictions remain distinct from measured dose and clinical decisions; readiness scores require named rubrics.

title: Separate structural links from ontology axioms
source_issue: The source lists ontology-style predicates beside data elements.
proposed_revision: Implement typed record links where appropriate and retain conceptual assertions for separately curated ontology mappings.
rationale: A Gen3 foreign-key-like link does not establish OWL equivalence, causal claims or class subsumption.

title: Version and review the evidence
source_issue: Definitions, example codes and numerical examples are preliminary.
proposed_revision: Retain source row/paragraph, definition, revision rationale and mapping review state; do not populate unverified clinical defaults.
rationale: Source examples and proposed mappings are not validated terminology, consensus, product labeling or prescribing instructions.

title: Make quantities unambiguous
source_issue: Half-life, fractions, dose quantities and units are inconsistent in some rows.
proposed_revision: Distinguish biological/physical/effective half-life; fraction/percent; absorbed dose/BED/EQD2; mass/moles; observed/predicted quantities.
rationale: Unit conversion requires a defined quantity, denominator, time basis and model assumptions.

title: Retain the Gen3 integration contract
source_issue: MIDRC measurements require patient-related parent links.
proposed_revision: Preserve existing nodes, properties, enums and link groups; reuse applicable scalar definitions in a separate nonpatient test node.
rationale: Batch QC cannot be submitted as a patient measurement without inventing a case or weakening the upstream schema.

title: Resolve duplicate and empty source entries
source_issue: Duplicate follows_regulatory_pathway, repeated route/excipient fields, a placeholder and an empty pharmacodynamics heading occur.
proposed_revision: Consolidate equivalent destinations, retain all source occurrences and add contextual pharmacodynamic evidence records.
rationale: Traceability is preserved without creating a second meaning for repeated labels or treating a work-allocation note as a clinical field.
